title: Everybody Wants to Rule the World — Ukulele Song-Form Accompaniment
description: Playable, song-structured high-G ukulele accompaniment using the documented harmony and characteristic rhythmic feel of “Everybody Wants to Rule the World”. Designed for practice, not a note-for-note original guitar, vocal, bass or lead-riff transcription.
body:
Introduction: Dmaj7 | G (repeat 3×)
Verse 1: Dmaj7 | G (repeat 3×)
Pre-refrain: F#m | G | Em | F#m (repeat 2×)
Refrain: Em | F#m | G | A | Dmaj7 | G (repeat 3×)
Verse 2: Dmaj7 | G (repeat 3×)
Refrain 2: Em | F#m | G | A | Dmaj7 | G (repeat 3×)
Instrumental passage: Dmaj7 | G | F#m | G (repeat 2×)
Final refrain: Em | F#m | G | A | Dmaj7 | G (repeat 2×)
Outro: Dmaj7 | G (repeat 2×)
notes:
High-G GCEA, no capo; concert pitch. One notated 6/8 measure is half an original 12/8 bar. Playback quarter-note tempo 168 approximates dotted-quarter pulse 112 BPM. Dmaj7–G shuttle and shuffle subdivisions.
Score section map: Introduction (1–6) · Verse 1 (7–12) · Pre-refrain (13–20) · Refrain (21–38) · Verse 2 (39–44) · Refrain 2 (45–62) · Instrumental passage (63–70) · Final refrain (71–82) · Outro (83–86).
Original meter where supported; some rhythmic/meter details are adapted to the current single-meter, single-voice score engine. Rhythmic parts are original and song-characteristic, not copied riffs. Slash-bass/inversion details beyond the ukulele range are omitted.
Source harmonies: https://freebasstranscriptions.com/transcriptions/tears-for-fears-everybody-wants-to-rule-the-world/
